subject: Budget range validation — monthly spend and procurement thresholds
messages:
From: Dylan Brooks <dylan@redwood.ai>
To: Sanjay Patel <sanjay@paybridge.com>
Cc: Marissa Cole <marissa@redwood.ai>, Aditya Rao <aditya@redwood.ai>
Date: Sat, 15 Aug 2026 09:12:00 -0700
Subject: Budget range validation — monthly spend and procurement thresholds

Hi Sanjay — great call earlier today, thanks for the time. Quick recap and a couple of asks so we can align the pricing/contract path with your procurement team:

Summary of what I heard
- Initial integration scope: customer support automation (routing + summarization) + search relevance re-ranker.
- Expected token volumes: rough estimate 50M–200M tokens/month in the first 6 months, with potential spike into the 300M–500M band if the pilot expands.
- Latency SLO: median <300ms for short-form responses, and occasional batch jobs for nightly re-ranking.

Pricing/qualification asks
1) Can you confirm the target monthly spend band you want to validate here (ballpark numbers are fine: e.g., $10k–$50k/month vs $50k–$250k/month)?
2) Procurement thresholds: what PO/contract value triggers procurement review vs legal/vendor security (i.e., who signs, what thresholds for vendor questionnaires)?
3) Do you require SOC 2 Type II and a redline-friendly MSA? Any required attestations (DPA, data residency)?

I'll put together a conservative pricing estimate for the volumes you gave and attach a worksheet (unit economics by model variant / token rate) — want to make sure we hit the right target $/1M tokens for your business case.

Proposed next steps
- You confirm the monthly spend band and procurement thresholds.
- I share a short pricing estimate and an SOW draft for procurement/legal to review.
- If that looks OK, schedule a procurement kickoff with your vendor ops team (we can join).

Thanks — looping Marissa for a pricing worksheet and to prepare an SOW draft.

Best,
Dylan Brooks
Account Executive | Redwood Inference
---
Attachment: redwood_pricing_estimate.xlsx (pricing worksheet)

From: Sanjay Patel <sanjay@paybridge.com>
To: Dylan Brooks <dylan@redwood.ai>
Cc: Claire Summers <claire@paybridge.com>, Marissa Cole <marissa@redwood.ai>
Date: Sun, 16 Aug 2026 11:03:00 -0700
Subject: Re: Budget range validation — monthly spend and procurement thresholds

Thanks for the clear recap, Dylan — useful. A few clarifications from our side:

1) Token volumes: our initial pilot (Q4) is likely to be ~80M–120M tokens/month. If the pilot meets KPIs, we expect production scale to be ~350M–450M tokens/month within 6–9 months.

2) Budget band: for the pilot we're budgeting approximately $15k–$40k/month. If we move to production scale, the monthly run rate budget is expected to be $60k–$200k/month (depending on usage patterns).

3) Procurement thresholds and timeline:
   - PO thresholds: internal procurement reviews any vendor spend >$25k/month.
   - Anything >$50k/month requires vendor security review + legal review and usually a signed MSA.
   - Typical procurement lead time is 4–6 weeks (procurement + legal).

4) Compliance: we will require SOC 2 Type II and a DPA. Data residency is US-only for this workload. We will likely have your security team complete our standard vendor questionnaire.

Once you share a pricing worksheet and a short SOW, I can introduce our procurement lead (Claire) and the vendor ops owner.

Thanks,
Sanjay
Head of Platform Partnerships | PayBridge
---
(Attached: initial vendor security checklist — Claire will push the full questionnaire when we loop procurement.)

From: Dylan Brooks <dylan@redwood.ai>
To: Sanjay Patel <sanjay@paybridge.com>
Cc: Marissa Cole <marissa@redwood.ai>, Aditya Rao <aditya@redwood.ai>
Date: Mon, 17 Aug 2026 09:47:00 -0700
Subject: Re: Budget range validation — monthly spend and procurement thresholds

Appreciate the detail, Sanjay — super helpful. Quick response and a starting unit-economics check so you can validate against the numbers your finance team will use.

High-level estimate (pilot volumes: 80M–120M tokens/month)
- Rough target unit price: $900–$1,200 per 1M tokens (this assumes our recommended model variant with quantization, moderate batching, and prefix caching).
- Example math: at $1,000 / 1M tokens, 100M tokens ≈ $100k/month. At $900 / 1M tokens, 80M tokens ≈ $72k/month.

Notes and caveats:
- The figure above is an illustrative list price estimate; final pricing can include committed discounts (reserved capacity) — which typically materially reduce $/1M at higher volumes and multi-month commits.
- We can optimize via batching/caching and recommending model variants to lower unit costs without degrading quality.
- For procurement-driven pilots we often structure a 3–6 month PoC with a committed minimum to get a better price while respecting your procurement thresholds.

Next steps I propose:
- Marissa to share the pricing worksheet (attached) and a short PoC SOW draft for procurement.
- Sanjay/Claire: please confirm the procurement contact and any internal PO/account numbers we should reference.
- I'll schedule a 30-minute procurement kickoff next week once we have the SOW.

If those unit numbers look out of band for you, tell me the target $/1M tokens you need to be viable and we can explore model/ops levers and committed terms that hit that target.

Best,
Dylan
Account Executive | Redwood Inference
